THIRD-SEED NOISE-FLOOR CHARACTERIZATION of the leader, not a fresh lift attempt. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, not CT pixels). (1) TRAJECTORY + the THREE seed reads: ep8/n200 hr0.276 -> ep20 0.339 -> ep27 0.3654 -> ep9/n579 0.3994 -> ep10/n579 SEED 42 hr 0.415794 (iter-6) -> iter-7 lr1.5e-4 REGRESSED 0.4133 -> iter-8 lambda_neg0.1 0.4140 -> ep10/n579 SEED 123 hr 0.421712 (iter-9, BEST, +0.0059 over seed 42). So the TWO seed reads at the otherwise-identical champion config are 0.4158 (seed 42) and 0.4217 (seed 123): a +0.006 init+noise swing -> dd_sup is SEED-SENSITIVE. (2) LIMITER: ALL FIVE compute/optimization lift levers are MAPPED and EXHAUSTED -- epochs WALL-PINNED at 10 (ep10 used 1176/1200s; ep11 BUSTS the 20-min wall), data coverage MAXED (train_n=579 = the ENTIRE Wagner pool, cannot rise), capacity REGRESSED (iter-4 c24/ep10 -> 0.29856, trading epochs to fund 2.25x conv-compute under-trained the bigger net), lr REGRESSED (iter-7 1.5e-4 -> 0.4133), lambda_neg flat (iter-8 0.1 -> 0.4140, the prior-TPE 0.1-best hint did NOT transfer under the corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). The only LIVE axis is the per-init noise floor: with two seed reads spanning 0.006, a THIRD seed is the highest-value remaining move -- it characterizes whether 0.4217 is a lucky-high or the typical level, which directly informs how real the #2-#4 podium gaps are. (3) ONE KNOB: seed 123 -> 7 (fresh, NOT 42 or 123). seed drives BOTH torch.manual_seed (U-Net init) AND the LDCT noise realization (train uses seed, val uses seed+1000), so it is the genuine init+noise-floor read. ZERO extra compute -- a seed change does not alter per-epoch cost, so the pinned ep10 wall stays SAFE (no epoch trade). (4) HYPOTHESIS: the 3rd seed lands inside the 0.416-0.422 band the two prior seeds define, characterizing the ~+/-0.003 init-noise floor around a ~0.419 mean. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr > 0.425 at seed=7, dd_sup is EVEN MORE seed-sensitive than the two-seed span suggested / 0.4217 was not a ceiling (the noise band is wider than +/-0.003) -> the #3 read is a lucky-high tail and the podium gaps to #2 are softer than they look. If hr < 0.415 at seed=7, then iter-9 0.4217 was the LUCKY-HIGH read and the typical dd_sup level is ~0.4158 (seed 42) or below -> 0.4217 over-states the leader. If 0.415 <= hr <= 0.425 (the expected case), the three seeds bracket a ~+/-0.003 init-noise floor around ~0.419 and 0.4217 is a representative-high, not anomalous -- file the noise-floor-characterized champion-ceiling verdict toward iter-20. PREDICTED iter-10 hr ~0.416-0.420 (most likely between the two prior reads, near the 0.419 two-seed mean). (5) BUDGET: seed change does NOT alter per-epoch cost -> ep10/train_n=579 stays ~1176s (19.6 min), inside the 1200s train+score wall and the 30-min sbatch wall; no epoch trade. val=ALL 214 L277 slices. (6) no control return.
